name: mcpscan
title: MCP Scan
description: An index of every MCP server on the internet. Crawls the public directories on a loop (the official registry, Smithery, Docker's MCP registry, GitHub, plus PulseMCP/Glama when a key is set), probes every endpoint it finds forever, hunts for endpoints nobody published, and re-exposes the whole thing as one MCP server: search 20k servers, read any one's real schemas, call any tool on any of them.
backend: scan-rs (Rust: axum REST index + crawler/prober loops + JSON-RPC 2.0 Streamable HTTP + stdio)

app.served_by: the API binary (single-page console compiled into it)

catalog.docs: Search the index: ?q= matches names, descriptions and tool names; ?status=live|auth|down|error|unknown; ?source=official|smithery|docker|github|pulsemcp|glama|hunt|probe; ?sort=relevance|tools|fast|recent|name; ?limit=&offset=; ?tools=1 returns each server's tool list

catalog/:id.docs: One indexed server: endpoint, every directory that lists it, install packages, last probe and its tools

catalog/:id/probe.docs: Re-probe one indexed server right now

stats.docs: Index size, live/auth/down/unprobed split, per-directory counts, and the scraper's telemetry (probes, batches, hunts, last crawl)

recent.docs: The scraper's live feed — servers whose status just changed, newest first

sources.docs: Per-directory crawl reports: rows found, new, updated, duration, error or the key it still needs

crawl.docs: {source?, wait?} — re-read every directory now (or one). Returns immediately unless wait:true

hunt.docs: {budget?} — knock on /mcp, /sse, /api/mcp … at the domains of servers that never published an endpoint; hits are added to the index

probe.docs: {url, headers?} — handshake with any MCP endpoint, index the result, return protocolVersion, serverInfo and the full tool list

call.docs: {server, tool, args, headers?} — call a tool on any indexed server (server = index id or endpoint URL). A fresh session per call; nothing has to be registered first

export.docs: ?status=live&format=json|ndjson|mcp — the index as data, or a paste-ready mcpServers config of every live server

client_config.docs: ?client=claude|cursor|vscode|json — paste-ready config pointing a client at this index

mcp.docs: The index as an MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0 Streamable HTTP; also `mcpscan-api --stdio`). Tools: mcp_find, mcp_server, mcp_tools, mcp_call, mcp_probe, mcp_stats

mcp.note: Twenty thousand servers is ~200k tools, which no client can list. So the aggregation is search + call rather than a flat union: mcp_find locates a server, mcp_tools reads its live schemas, mcp_call runs the tool.

sources.official: registry.modelcontextprotocol.io — the MCP project's own registry, cursor-paginated, version=latest (keyless)
sources.smithery: registry.smithery.ai — the largest third-party directory; deployed servers are reachable at server.smithery.ai/{name}/mcp (keyless to list)
sources.github: GitHub repo search on a rotating set of queries and pages, so the long tail gets covered over time (keyless; a token raises the rate limit)
sources.pulsemcp: api.pulsemcp.com v0.1 — needs PULSEMCP_API_KEY (v0beta is being sunset)
sources.hunt: not a directory: endpoints this module found by knocking on the domain of a server nobody published an endpoint for

scraper.crawl: every MCPSCAN_CRAWL_SECS (default 6h): re-read every directory, merge by id and by endpoint URL
scraper.probe: continuous: batches of MCPSCAN_BATCH endpoints whose re-check clock is due, forever
scraper.reprobe_clocks: live 6h · auth 12h · error 12h · down 6h, doubling per consecutive failure up to 14 days
scraper.hunt: every MCPSCAN_HUNT_SECS (default 120s): MCPSCAN_HUNT_BATCH domains, one knock per domain per 30 days, code hosts and package registries skipped

id.description: Index id — slug of the server's canonical name

url.description: Streamable HTTP/SSE endpoint; empty for a package-only (stdio) server, which is still indexed

sources.description: Every directory that lists it — one server in three directories is one row

packages.description: How to run it locally, e.g. npm:@foo/bar, docker:mcp/foo

status.description: live = shook hands anonymously; auth = the endpoint is there and wants a credential; error = something answered and it wasn't MCP; down = nothing answered; unknown = not probed yet (or no endpoint to probe)

tools.description: Tool names + short descriptions from the last successful probe — searchable

fails.description: Consecutive failed probes; drives the re-check backoff

auth.writes: crawl and hunt need Bearer ~/.mod/mcpscan/server.secret when that file exists; open otherwise. ACCESS_OPEN=1 forces open
auth.note: call/probe reach third-party servers with only the headers the caller supplies — this module holds no credentials for anyone else's server

env.MCPSCAN_PUBLIC_URL: Public base URL used in client_config (default http://localhost:50700)
env.MCPSCAN_HUNT_COOLDOWN: Seconds before a domain may be knocked on again (default 2592000)
env.MCPSCAN_GITHUB_TOKEN: GitHub token — raises the search rate limit
env.SMITHERY_API_KEY: Optional; listing is keyless, a key raises limits

related.mcp: orbit/mcp is the hub that aggregates servers you have chosen — register this module there and one client reaches both the fleet and the whole internet
